description: Comprehensive SIH1709 Controlled Evaluation Suite covering Valid, Incomplete, Contradictory, and Edge-Case official document scenarios.

cases.test_intent: Golden Standard: Fully valid B.Tech Degree Certificate from IIT Bombay with complete fields and consistent dates.

Date of Issue: 15/07/2023
Given under the seal of the Institute.
